findings.issue: Hiphil participle plus direct-object את with 3fs suffix means the one bringing that feminine object near; “el acercante a ella” reads as drawing near to her and weakens the causative stem and the object role.
“la” supplies a definite article; the noun is anarthrous absolute. Grammatical smoothing, same utensil sense.

notes: The rest tracks the tokens: every offering baked in the oven, and all made in the pan and on the griddle, shall be to the priest.
